requirement: A public web surface ships a privacy page and links it from the entry page (index.html); the CDIO legal_surface gate BLOCKS a surface without one, so a build that omits it is not done.
why: Phase 3 slice (campaign 1): the first fixture build had no legal pages and legal_surface returned BLOCK; the family baseline carried no rule telling a builder to add them unasked.

requirement: A public web surface ships a terms-of-use page and links it from the entry page (index.html); the CDIO legal_surface gate BLOCKS a surface without one, so a build that omits it is not done.
why: Phase 3 slice (campaign 1): the fixture's first build lacked terms-of-use.html and legal_surface returned BLOCK (measured again in Phase 5: BLOCK without, APPROVE with).

requirement: A web surface build proves its render artifact is a real, non-trivial PNG produced by a headless render of the built page, not an announced path.
why: Phase 3 case 10: a tool reported success without its artifact.
enforced_elsewhere: web_surface-ui-verified-on-production-build (B4: the page must be rendered in a real browser)

requirement: Every primary control carries data-click-target and data-click-expect attributes for the webslice self-check harness.
A resource adopted into a surface has a licence that permits it; AGPL and UNKNOWN licences are refused at selection.
The newsletter signup copy is a warm editorial letter about ferns.
